Hello, my name is Gabriela Shirley! 

I am a Software Engineer. 

Graduated from the [University of California, San Diego](https://ucsd.edu/) Class of 2021 majoring in __Computer Science__.

I am driven to expand my horizons in different types of fields and hope to use my accumulated knowledge to make an impact on my community and even the world. Although I am focusing on Web and Mobile App development, I am also studying design and human cognition in order to combine both my technical and personal skills and create new applications that will ultimately help others.

Please feel free to reach me out for any inquiries! (◔ᴥ◔)
